# weka_object_store_attachment (Data Source)

Look up an existing object store bucket attachment by its "<filesystem_id>/<object_store_bucket_id>" id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "weka_object_store_attachment" "tiering" {
  id = "fs-uid/bucket-uid"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) <filesystem_id>/<object_store_bucket_id>.

### Read-Only

- `filesystem_id` (String) UID of the filesystem the bucket is attached to.
- `mode` (String) Attachment mode reported by the cluster: WRITABLE for a local (tiering) bucket, REMOTE for a remote (snapshot) bucket.
- `object_store_bucket_id` (String) UID of the attached weka_object_store_bucket.
